text: A type A: U is an n-type iff the type (A = B): U is an (n-1)-type for all B: U. This shows:
choices: the universe U is a set
the h-level of the universe is one higher than the types it contains
all types in U have the same h-level
explanation: Paths in U (types of equivalences) have h-level one lower than U itself. U is not a set; it is at best a 1-groupoid (with equiv as morphisms). This is the homotopy content of univalence.
